tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Page ground and hero stages. Klinfits is a dark-first brand: every page starts here.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Raised chrome on black: global bar, sticky nav, footer, photo stage.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Tiles and full-width bands (feature tiles, order steps, the sizes band).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines and borders on graphite or carbon. Never text.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Outlines of secondary pill buttons on black; muted labels on the light card (4.7:1 on porcelain).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Muted body copy and metadata on black (5.8:1) or carbon (4.7:1).

tokens.name: porcelain
tokens.usage: Main text on dark grounds; background of the light spec card.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cells inside the light spec card.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Track of the segmented size switch on the light card.

tokens.name: hairline-light
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between cells on the light card.

tokens.name: silver-100
tokens.usage: Start stop of the metallic gradient (primary pills, headline highlight).

tokens.name: silver-300
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the metallic gradient; eyebrow labels and line icons on black (10:1).

tokens.name: silver-500
tokens.usage: End stop of the metallic gradient. Black text on it still passes (4.9:1).

tokens.name: on-silver
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the metallic gradient.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page, the hero headline. Always uppercase. Scales down to 56px on phones.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Section openers. Uppercase, two short lines max.

styles.name: display-sub
styles.usage: Smaller uppercase headings and CTA tiles.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the logo in the global bar and the tagline in the footer. Uppercase, wide tracking.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Label above a headline, in silver-300.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Black Line compression tee. Fitted enough to show the work, soft enough that you forget it's on.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the hero headline, in ash.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Measurements and numbers on the spec card.

styles.name: nav

styles.name: caption

styles.usage: Labels on the spec card, footer notes.
